Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production regional search terrain backdrop for a fantasy cartography dice game, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.
Input images: the game's hunting map and village drawing are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not an edit target. Match their fine sepia engraved outlines, selective parallel and crosshatching, low-saturation transparent watercolor and warm ivory parchment ground. All volumes drawn in ink, paper showing through the pale color washes, handmade printed atlas feeling, no photographic textures or 3D lighting.
Primary request: an intimate regional terrain map, a closer aerial-oblique view of one hunting ground that makes the player imagine walking and searching there, not a distant whole-world map.
Terrain: A remote alpine hunting ground: a dramatic chain of jagged snowy peaks across the upper edge, slate-grey stepped rock ridges at the left and right, small dark pine stands, an icy blue meltwater stream threading down a side valley. A winding high mountain pass comes toward the viewer through a broad pale snow-dusted clearing. Snowfields and sparse contour hatching describe the open center. Cold, quiet, hazardous; muted slate blue, pale sage and sepia. No sea or volcanic lava.
Critical functional composition: clear and attractive terrain silhouettes around the OUTER edges. The middle x18%-82%, y22%-81% is a very light, quiet natural clearing in the same terrain, with only a few faint contour strokes, almost unmarked ivory/ash/sand/snow. It will hold live HTML dice and a six-cell search field. This region must have no dense hatching, rocks, trees, cave mouths, water or lava. It is NOT a rectangular blank paper, table, board, parchment scroll, framed panel or UI box; the surrounding terrain transitions organically into the open center. A winding faint trail approaches this clearing from a lower corner, staying out of the central area. Keep top and side terrain strongly identifiable at a small size, lower edge sparse. Light antique paper shows around the map's irregular exterior.
Constraints: no text, labels, letters, numbers, compass letters, UI, dice, grids, slots, buttons, frame, people, beasts, buildings, glowing effects or watermark. No photorealism, glossy render, dramatic shadows, dark vignette or richly saturated color. A hand-drawn terrain illustration only.
